system.description:
You walk between the living and the spirit, the present and the ancestral. Where Druids tend the natural world, Shamans bargain with what lies beneath it.

  • Ancestor's Fury: while you are in Wild Shape, one hit of your choice each round deals an extra 1d4 damage of a type you choose.
    • 9th level: 1d8.
  • Spirit Sight: Advantage on checks to perceive, speak with or identify spirits, ancestors and natural extraplanar beings. During a long rest you may ask the spirits one yes or no question about the area or a creature nearby; the answer comes as an impression.
